description: This file defines a Java interface named SystemConfigurationService which extends a generic service interface and includes a method for retrieving system configuration by key, potentially throwing a ServiceException.

classes.name: SystemConfigurationService
classes.description: A service interface for handling system configuration entities, providing methods for retrieval and management of configurations.

methods.name: getByKey
methods.description: Retrieves a SystemConfiguration entity based on the provided key, may throw ServiceException if retrieval fails.
